description: Return daily European Central Bank reference exchange rates and bounded cross-rates. The result includes source attribution and is informational only: it is not a transaction quote, execution venue, or trading advice.

base_currency.description: Three-letter ISO currency code used as the base.

date.description: Optional ECB publication date, today or up to 31 days in the past.

quotes.description: Optional quote currencies; omit to return all currencies in the selected ECB publication.

name: get_fx_rates_ecb
